summary: Welltower OP LLC, a subsidiary of Welltower Inc., filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) for a public offering of two series of senior unsecured notes denominated in Canadian dollars. The offering amounts and coupon rates are left as placeholders, and the notes are fully and unconditionally guaranteed by Welltower Inc. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. The notes will not be listed on any exchange. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction with no special-situation characteristics—no change of control, merger, restructuring, or activist event. Watch for final pricing and closing mechanics.
